protocol.name: nidara_drag_feedback_v1

description.summary: destination intent for the compositor's drag cursor

protocol.description: Wayland negotiates Copy, Move and Ask, but has no Link action. A destination that makes a reference can describe that intent without pretending to move or copy the source's files. This extension changes only the cursor; it grants no acceptance, transfer, launch, focus or layout permission.

entry.name: open
entry.summary: open with the target, Copy cursor

request.name: set_feedback
request.description: surface must be the caller's current drag destination. serial is the wl_data_device.enter serial for this visit, not a pointer-enter serial. Requests from another surface, an earlier visit or an ended drag are ignored. The hint never survives leaving the surface, drop, cancel or destruction of the object that supplied it. Open and Pin apply only while the negotiated action is Copy. Without this optional global, destinations continue using the standard negotiated cursor.
